methods.steps: ffmpeg -i title.vob -c:v libx264 -c:a aac title.mkv
methods.limits: Add -map to pick specific audio tracks.

methods.steps: Open Source; pick the VOB or VIDEO_TS folder; choose a title with the Title control; set the container to MKV; encode.
methods.limits: Does not process copy-protected DVD sources.

methods.steps: Add VOB; Output Format: MKV; review Encoder Options; Convert.
methods.limits: Windows only.

methods.steps: Add the VOB; set Output Format to MP3; review Encoder Options; Convert.
methods.limits: Windows version.

methods.steps: ffmpeg -i chapter.vob -vn -c:a libmp3lame -b:a 192k chapter.mp3
methods.limits: Add -map to pick a specific audio track.

methods.steps: File > Open the AVIF; File > Export As and save it as an ICO; review the icon options for each size.
methods.limits: Needs a GIMP release that imports AVIF.

methods.steps: avifdec artwork.avif decoded.png; open the PNG in GIMP and export it as ICO.
methods.limits: Two applications; icon options must still be reviewed.

methods.steps: With Ink/Stitch installed, File > Open in Inkscape and choose the DST; File > Export PNG Image; open the PNG in GIMP and export it as a JPEG.
methods.limits: Ink/Stitch must be installed in Inkscape.

methods.steps: pattern = pyembroidery.read_dst("design.dst"); pyembroidery.write_png(pattern, "preview.png"); then magick preview.png preview.jpg
methods.limits: Needs Python and ImageMagick.

methods.steps: magick picture.jfif picture.webp
methods.limits: Needs an ImageMagick build with WebP support.

methods.steps: For color input: jpegtopnm photo.jpg > photo.ppm
methods.limits: Grayscale input yields PGM, not PPM.

methods.steps: Open JPG; File > Export As; choose PPM; select ASCII or raw data formatting.
methods.limits: RGB without alpha.

methods.steps: magick photo.jpg photo.ppm
methods.limits: filename-based conversion; verify variant.

methods.steps: ffmpeg -i song.m4a -vn song.wma
methods.limits: Needs an FFmpeg build with the matching decoder and a WMA encoder.

methods.steps: Open M4A; File > Save As; select WMA.
methods.limits: WMA saving is documented on Windows, not Mac.

methods.steps: Open M4R; File > Save As; select WAV and review encoding.
methods.limits: M4R input is Windows-only in the cited support table.

methods.steps: Add M4R; Output Format: WAV; Encoder Options; Convert.
methods.limits: Copy-protected files are excluded.

methods.steps: ffmpeg -i tone.m4r -vn tone.wav
methods.limits: Needs an FFmpeg build with the AAC decoder.

methods.steps: ffmpeg -i recording.m4v recording.avi
methods.limits: Needs an FFmpeg build with the matching decoders and encoders.

methods.steps: Add M4V; Output Format: AVI; inspect Encoder Options; Convert.
methods.limits: Windows only.

methods.steps: Add MOV; choose FLV Output Format; review Encoder Options; Convert.
methods.limits: Windows only.

methods.steps: ffmpeg -i take.mov -c:a aac -f flv -c:v libx264 take.flv
methods.limits: Needs an FFmpeg build with libx264.
